# Oli Treadwell

Senior Software Engineer and Accessibility Advocate in Wellington, New Zealand. 10+ years building for the web: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, C#/.NET, PostgreSQL.

Also leads AI-assisted software delivery inside teams, not just personal use of the tools: building the agentic layer (MCP tooling, agent consumable checklists, review agents), rolling it out to a delivery team, owning CI/CD pipelines, build gates and monitoring, and working with LLM APIs and multi-agent pipelines. Teaches ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot use with the standard that the developer demonstrates understanding of the code rather than outsourcing it. Developed "The Cognitively-Kind Web," a framework for accessibility across diverse cognitive processing styles.

## Open source highlights

- [ai-harness](https://github.com/olitreadwell/ai-harness): one versioned home for AI coding-agent configuration, 127 skills validated against the agentskills.io spec, plus global instructions and subagent roles.
- [react-performance-checklist](https://github.com/olitreadwell/react-performance-checklist): 34 React performance rules held as data, with an MCP server so an agent can list rules, fetch one, and plan an audit or fix.
- [pr-vetting](https://github.com/olitreadwell/pr-vetting): dependency-free Python CLI and GitHub Action that tiers pull request authors from public GitHub signals.

## Employment

- Senior Software Engineer, Numeral Studio, Feb 2025 to Jun 2026 (role made redundant).
- Principal Engineer and Technical Consultant, Habitual Genesis, 2016 to present.
